item.content:encoded:
The local networking group, Ladies Out Lunching – LOL for short – will host their July Luncheon at Lost Pizza Company in Benton, Wednesday, August 19th from 12:00 – 1:00 pm. 

Come ready to chat and make some new friends! 

Luncheon Details:

– Lunch is Dutch Treat: just order and pay your meal.

– Don’t forget to bring your business cards and materials!

– Happy Gift: If you would like a minute to share about your business bring a small gift or some business swag to share! We will draw for a recipient and you get a chance to share – everyone loves a present… right?

NONPROFIT SUPPORT! This month we are collecting nonperishable food items and feminine hygiene products for local food pantries.

LOL meets the 3rd Wednesday of each month at various restaurants around Saline County.  Learn more about LOL and RSVP to an event by visiting  www.facebook.com/groups/ladiesoutlunching/

Browse MySaline’s full list of all the events in Saline County at www.mysaline.com/events

  • Games begin at 5 p.m. 

Where

The address is 6707 Benton Road, Bauxite, Ar. It’s the big yellow building with columns. 

Directions from Benton: Take Edison/Hwy 183 and turn right before Bauxite Post Office.

Directions from Bryant: Take Reynolds/Hwy 183 and turn left after Bauxite Post Office.

Games

  • Backups must be purchased with Pack. Ten games per pack.
  • Mini – 4 games of Chicken Feed and 1 game of Checkmark.
  • Must have Mini Pack to Play Checkmark game.

Prices

  • Pack – 10 games plus Early Bird Mini of five games plus one free game/card-$15.00
  • Backup – 10 games (identical to Pack of 10 games) – $10.00
  • Minis/Special Games – Games 9, 12, 16, 19 and 21- $1.00 per card or 6 cards for $5.00
  • No checks will be accepted.

Important Details

  • There will be concessions.
  • There’s a 50/50 raffle.
  • No outside food or drink will be allowed. 
  • This is a smoke free environment but it is allowed outside.
  • Proceeds to benefit Bauxite Historical Association Museum (BHAM).

See MySaline’s list of all the events in Saline County at www.mysaline.com/events
